title: 第857章 他们都是妖界人第856章 聪明反被聪明误
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: “是我，小瞧你了。”
听到这话，林筱悬在半空的心一下放回肚子里。
她就知道，像烛冥昪玦这样傲慢自私的人，怎么可能愿意和她们一群小小化神一起死。
同时，她对烛冥昪玦的忌惮更上一个等级。
越是实力强大的上位者，越在乎自己的脸面，而烛冥昪玦能忍下她们的威胁挑衅，可见他并不是个拘泥颜面，受不得折辱的人。
有天赋有实力，有脑子能屈能伸，手段狠辣，心肠狠毒，这样的人不能为友，那就必须尽快斩杀。
他活着每一秒，就如一把锋利的刀架在脖子上。
如果可以，林筱真的想用天劫直接将烛冥昪玦劈死完事，可是不行，她还必须放烛冥昪玦走，任由这把刀一直在她脖子上来回摩擦试探。
到底还是，她太弱了。
烛冥昪玦有退路，以他的实力就算被妖界追杀也不怕，而她却只能以自己的性命为代价，引动天劫来赌一把。
她有把握赢，但在烛冥昪玦沉默的那几秒钟，她也提着心。
她赌赢了，可付出的代价也是惨重的。
她向天道暴露了她的位置。
天劫的第一道雷响，她就清楚，她的合体劫将会和化神劫一样凶险。
她习惯未雨绸缪，不喜突发情况，更讨厌被迫改变主意与想法。
知晓自己的合体劫可能会不同寻常，她想着等一切解决完了，稳定下来，再做准备引合体劫。
没想到，她引合体劫会是在这种迫不得已的情形下。
她很少遇到超出掌控的情况，但她会记住这种感觉。
烛冥昪玦心念一动，拉开一道裂缝对林筱道，“从这里出去，带着你的天劫有多远走多远。”
林筱正要行动，突然捕捉到一个词，烛冥昪玦说的是你，而不是你们。
仿佛看出林筱想什么，烛冥昪玦撇嘴，这狐妖真把他当善人了，放她一个离开已是万不得已的魄力，其余妖他还要留着吞噬复活呢。
既然都得罪妖界了，不在乎多杀一些少杀一些。
林筱迈出的脚步收了回来。
她也不说话，就那么静静看着烛冥昪玦，意思很明确，只放她一个，不行。
烛冥昪玦其实不意外林筱这个行为，但他始终不理解，换成他，有活命的机会他早就跑了，其他人，和他有什么关系？
也许有人会骂他冷血，可那又如何，言语又不会使他掉块肉。
通常那些人只敢在他背后骂他，遇到他本人连个屁都不敢放。
他何必在乎连他一根毫毛都伤不到的蝼蚁，不顺心了，随手碾死就是。
亲情友情爱情，他从不需要，他只需要让世间一切生物臣服畏惧的强大实力。
“你们妖界也就是数量上比较占优势，不然第一界域的名号怎会轮得到你们。”
嘲讽完，烛冥昪玦目光从元逍北亘越等人身上扫过，全都是和林筱关系比较亲近的，“你们几个，也可以走。”
放了这几个小家伙也好，都是圣兽族群的天骄，他虽然不怕妖界，但强敌能少一个是一个。
他敢打赌，就算他杀了那么多妖，妖界也不会联合起来围杀他，当没损伤到自己的利益，大多数族群第一选择永远是冷眼旁观。
“这回可以了吧？”烛冥昪玦自认，他这辈子的仁慈都在这儿了。
没被选上的妖面色灰白，他们预料到烛冥昪玦不会放过他们，可还是心存一丝希望。
content_en:
"It's me, I underestimated you."
Hearing this, Lin Xiao's heart suddenly dropped into her stomach.
She knew how could an arrogant and selfish person like Zhu Mingminjue be willing to die with these little transformed gods.
At the same time, her fear of Zhu Mingming Jue reached a new level.
The more powerful the superiors are, the more they care about their own face, and Zhu Mingming Jue can tolerate their threats and provocations, which shows that he is not a person who sticks to his face and cannot bear humiliation.
He has talent, strength, brains that can bend and stretch, ruthless methods, and a vicious heart. Such people cannot be friends, so they must be killed as soon as possible.
Every second of his life was like a sharp knife on his neck.
If possible, Lin Xiao really wanted to use the Heavenly Tribulation to kill Zhu Mingming Jue directly, but that was not possible. She had to let Zhu Mingmingming go and let the knife keep rubbing and testing on her neck.
After all, she is too weak.
Zhu Ming Minjue had a way out, and with his strength, he was not afraid even if he was chased by the demon world, but she could only risk her own life by triggering a catastrophe.
She was sure of winning, but during those few seconds when Zhu Mingming was silent, she was worried.
She won the bet, but the price she paid was heavy.
She revealed her location to Heaven.
With the first thunder of the heavenly calamity, she knew that her combined calamity would be as dangerous as the divine calamity.
She is used to planning ahead, doesn't like emergencies, and hates being forced to change her mind and ideas.
Knowing that her combined calamity might be unusual, she thought that she would wait until everything was resolved and stabilized before preparing for the combined calamity.
Unexpectedly, she would be in such a desperate situation to induce the body robbery.
She rarely encounters situations that are beyond her control, but she remembers the feeling.
With a thought in his mind, Zhu Ming Minjue opened a crack and said to Lin Xiao, "Get out of here and carry your calamity with you as far as you can."
Lin Xiao was about to take action when he suddenly caught a word. Zhu Mingming was talking about you, not you.
As if he could tell what Lin Xiao was thinking, Zhu Ming Minjue curled his lips. This fox demon really regarded him as a good person. Letting her go was a last resort. He would keep the other demons to devour and resurrect him.
Since we have offended the demon world, we don’t care whether we kill more or less.
Lin Xiao took back the steps he took.
She didn't say anything, and just looked at Zhu Ming Minjue quietly. Her meaning was very clear, just let her alone, no.
Zhu Mingming Jue was actually not surprised by Lin Xiao's behavior, but he still didn't understand. If it were him, he would have run away long ago if he had the chance to survive. What does other people have to do with him?
Some people may call him cold-blooded, but so what, words won't make him lose any flesh.
Usually those people only dare to scold him behind his back, but they don't even dare to fart when they meet him in person.
Why should he care about the ants that can't even hurt him? If something doesn't go his way, he can just crush them to death.
He never needs family, friendship, or love. He only needs the powerful strength to make all creatures in the world surrender to fear.
"You in the Demon Realm have the upper hand in terms of numbers. Otherwise, how would you get the title of the First Realm?"
After taunting, Zhu Mingming Jue glanced at Yuan Xiaobei Genyue and others, all of whom were relatively close to Lin Xiao, "You guys can go too."
It doesn't matter if these little guys are released, they are all the geniuses of the holy beast clan. Although he is not afraid of the demon world, he can have one less powerful enemy.
He bets that even if he kills so many demons, the demon world will not unite to surround him. As long as their own interests are not harmed, the first choice of most ethnic groups is always to watch indifferently.
"Is it okay this time?" Zhu Mingming Jue thought to himself that all his kindness in this life was here.
The faces of the demons who were not selected were ashen. They expected that Zhu Mingming would not let them go, but they still had a glimmer of hope.
